_note: Placeholder words for the D1 links and periodic table upgrade (periodic table and molecules pages). COPYWRITER MAIN replaces the values; keys are stable. Words in {braces} are filled in by the page.
pt.statUsedSub: elements build every molecule in this app
pt.statMolsSub: molecules, counted atom by atom from their structure files
pt.statAtomsSub: atoms in those files, {carbon} of them carbon
pt.lifeOn: Lit up: the {n} elements found in this app's molecules. The small number is how many of the {mols} molecules contain it.
pt.molOn: {name} is made of {n} elements: {list}. The small number is how many atoms of each are in its structure file.
card.noShells: No shell diagram here: the electron configuration on file does not add up to {z} electrons, so only the nucleus and its {z} protons are shown.
card.shellsNote: Added up from the electron configuration. A simple picture: real electrons do not circle like planets.
card.foundChipLabel: {count} {element} atoms in {name}. Opens {name} in 3D with every {element} atom lit up.
card.foundNone: None of the molecules in this app contain {name}.
land.help: Drag to turn, scroll or pinch to zoom. Pick a column to open its card. Arrow keys move between elements, Enter opens the card.
land.gaps: Flat tiles: the source gives no value for {n} elements.
land.log: Log scale: densities run from light gases to heavy metals.
land.noWebgl: The 3D landscape needs WebGL, which this browser or device does not offer. The table above shows every element.
land.failed: The 3D landscape could not start on this device. The table shows every element.
land.alt: 3D landscape of the periodic table. Each element is a column and its height shows {prop}. Highest: {top}. Lowest: {bottom}.
mol.lightOn: Showing only the {count} {element} atoms, in gold. Everything else is faded.
mol.elChipLabel: {element}, {count} atoms. Opens the periodic table with the elements of {name} lit up.
mol.whereNone: No cell model in this app points to this molecule yet.
mol.sizeLine: {n} atoms in this file, {times} times as many as {smallest} ({min}).
mol.sizeNoH: This file lists no hydrogen atoms, so the real molecule has more.
mol.cineOnLabel: Open the cinematic DNA view: an illustrative double helix with real proportions
mol.cineFailed: The cinematic view could not start on this device. The real structure is still here.
pt.footNote: Electrons per shell are added up from the RSC electron configuration. Molecule links are counted from each structure file in this app (RCSB PDB).
